rateLimited: Akwai buƙatu da yawa a yanzu. Don Allah sake gwadawa nan ba da daɗewa ba.
requestFailed: Ba mu iya kammala wannan buƙatar ba. Don Allah sake gwadawa.
writeUncertain: Sabar ba ta amsa ba, don haka ba a san ko an adana wannan ba. Za a sake karanta shi da zarar an haɗa ku.
serverUnreachable: Ba za a iya isa sabar ba. Sake gwadawa da zarar an haɗa ta.
readUnanswered: Ba za a iya isa sabar ba. Za a sake karanta shi da zarar an haɗa ku.
unreachableOpenPage: Ba a iya buɗe shafin ba: ba za a iya isa sabar ba.
unreachableCreatePage: Ba a iya ƙirƙirar shafin ba: ba za a iya isa sabar ba.
unreachableSave: Ba a iya adana canjin ba: ba za a iya isa sabar ba.

backend.workspaceAdminRequired: Ana buƙatar damar admin na wurin aiki.
backend.workspaceOwnerRequired: Ana buƙatar damar mai wurin aiki.
backend.onlyOwnersAssignAdmin: Masu wurin aiki ne kawai za su iya ba da matsayin admin.
backend.onlyOwnersManageAdmins: Masu wurin aiki ne kawai za su iya sarrafa admin.
backend.onlyOwnersRemoveAdmins: Masu wurin aiki ne kawai za su iya cire admin.
backend.ownersCannotChangeRole: Ba za a iya canza matsayin mai wurin aiki a nan ba. Da farko a miƙa ikon mallaka.
backend.ownersCannotBeRemoved: Ba za a iya cire mai wurin aiki ba. Da farko a miƙa ikon mallaka.
backend.cannotChangeOwnRole: Ba za ku iya canza matsayinku na wurin aiki ba.
backend.cannotRemoveSelf: Ba za ku iya cire kanku daga wurin aiki ba.
backend.onlyAssignableRoles: Matsayin admin, memba, da baƙo ne kawai ake iya bayarwa.
backend.memberNotFound: Ba a sami wannan memban wurin aiki ba.
backend.invitationNotFound: Ba a sami wannan gayyata ba.
backend.transferTargetMustBeMember: Zaɓi wani memba da za a miƙa masa ikon mallaka.
backend.emailInvalid: Wannan adireshin imel ɗin bai yi daidai ba.
backend.externalGuestDisabled: An kashe gayyatar baƙi na waje bisa manufar ƙungiya.
backend.verifiedDomainRequired: Dole ne membobin ƙungiya su yi amfani da domain ɗin ƙungiya da aka tabbatar.
backend.workspaceUrlInUse: An riga an yi amfani da wannan URL ɗin wurin aiki.
backend.mcpConnectionsFull: Kun kai iyakar haɗin wakili. Cire haɗin wanda ba ku ƙara amfani da shi a Saituna → Fasaloli → Wakilai, sannan sake gwadawa.
backend.mcpConnectionHttpsRequired: Adireshin wannan sabar ba HTTPS ba ne, don haka wakilai ba za su iya haɗawa da ita ba. Kunna adireshin jama'a, ko buɗe Leafen a adireshin localhost ɗinta sannan ku haɗa a can.
backend.mcpConnectionCodesFull: Akwai lambobin haɗi da yawa da ba a yi amfani da su ba tukuna. Lambobin suna ƙarewa bayan minti 10, don haka sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
backend.invitationsFull: Akwai gayyata da yawa da ke jira. Soke wasu da farko.
backend.dlpPolicyBlocked: Manufar hana asarar bayanai ta ƙungiyar ku tana hana wannan.
backend.organizationStorageLimitExceeded: An kai iyakar ajiyar ƙungiyar ku, don haka ba a iya loda wannan ba. Tambayi admin na ƙungiya ya ƙara iyakar ko ya share fayiloli.
backend.appVersionRevoked: Wani kundin manhajoji ya soke wannan sigar, don haka ba a shigar da ita ba. Loda wata sigar.
backend.appInTrash: Wannan manhajar tana cikin Shara, don haka ba a sabunta ta ba. Maido da ita daga jerin manhajoji, sannan ku sabunta ta.
backend.appInTrashAskAdministrator: Wannan manhajar tana cikin Shara, don haka ba a ƙara ta ba. Tambayi admin ya maido da ita.
backend.serverDiskLow: Faifan sabar ya kusan cika, don haka ba a iya ajiye wannan ba. Tambayi admin na sabar ya saki sarari; zai sake aiki da zarar an sami wuri.
backend.organizationStorageRecounting: Ana sake kirga amfani da ajiyar ƙungiyar ku, don haka dole loda ya jira ɗan lokaci. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
backend.samlFieldsRequired: Cika filin issuer, URL ɗin shiga na mai ba da ainihi, da takardar shaidarsa.
backend.samlIssuerInvalid: Dole mai bayarwa ya zama URL ko URN, kamar https://idp.example.com/metadata.
backend.samlLoginUrlNotHttps: URL ɗin shiga na mai ba da ainihi dole ne ya fara da https://.
backend.samlCertificateInvalid: Dole takardar shaida ta zama takardar X.509 guda ɗaya a sigar PEM, tana farawa da -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
backend.samlEnforcementNeedsSso: Kunna SAML SSO kafin a buƙaci ta.
backend.legalHoldKeeps: Riƙon doka yana kare wannan, don haka ba za a iya share shi ba. Za ku iya share shi da zarar an saki riƙon.
backend.memberDeactivated: An kashe wannan mutum a cikin ƙungiya, don haka ba za a iya ƙara shi ba. Dole admin na ƙungiya ya sake kunna shi da farko.
backend.samlLinkedWorkspaceInvalid: Dole wurin aikin da aka haɗa ya kasance ɗaya daga cikin wuraren aikin ƙungiyar.
backend.samlRequiredPerson: Ƙungiyar wannan mutum tana ba da izinin shiga ta hanyar SSO kawai. A gaya wa mutumin ya shiga da asusun kamfaninsa.
backend.permissionDenied: Izinin shigarka a nan bai yarda da wannan canji ba. Ka roƙi wanda zai iya gyara shi ya ba ka izini.
backend.notionMigrationMovedBefore: An riga an matsar da wannan zuwa wannan wurin aiki, ko ana matsar da shi, don haka sabon shigo da shi zai ninka kowane shafi. Don kawo abin da ya canza a Notion kawai, ka danna “Sake shigo da canje-canje” a matsar da aka yi a baya.
